title: Apteki Mareshki
description: Mareshki Pharmacies (Apteki Mareshki) is one of the largest and most influential pharmaceutical chains in Bulgaria, founded in 1991 by businessman and politician Veselin Mareshki. The company operates over 290 locations across more than 120 towns, commanding a massive market share by offering budget-friendly medications, cosmetics, and health products. While the brand does not maintain an exhaustive, dedicated public profile on ZoomInfo.com, its corporate operations are typically analyzed under its parent holding structures, such as Pharmahold, which manages the group's extensive wholesale and retail distribution network.
